{{Quote|Unfortunately, I have very little information on the Vortex group. Alliance HQ indicates that they are a friendly organization dedicated to locating Light-side Jedi and recruiting them to the Rebel cause. They are a very secretive part of the Alliance which is why you need to be a full faction member of the Alliance before you can join them.|[[V3-FX]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Vortex Squadron''' was one of many [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their missions revolved around Alliance attempts to revive the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
